note: Ironclad Arbalist (unit identity, Ironclad): pillager biped, ember-banded kettle hat over a mail aventail, brigandine, crossed-bolt surcoat, fur mantle, back quiver, crossbow held level. Tier II brass studs and rims, a bevor, bracers and a banded quiver; tier III a brass-rimmed shoulder plate, an ember-seamed hat comb, brass goggles, greaves. No back flag.
